commits.body:

- Add turn-based tool call deduplication in chatMessageConverter and claudeCodeMessageConverter to prevent duplicate tool use entries when combining history and live messages
- Sort messages by timestamp before processing to ensure correct dedup order
- Handle tool_use SDK message type alongside tool_progress in messageNormalizer with permission request support
